cases.name: Australia Landingham
cases.about: She was just days away from celebrating her 50th wedding anniversary. "She was a kind, sweet, loving person," said Walter Landingham, her husband. Her nephew said, "She loved everyone," Isaiah Allen said. "She was a God-fearing woman and she would give you anything."
